meta.description: Luma.Green puts India's scrap chain on one platform: households, kabadiwalas, yards, recyclers and manufacturers, with fair prices, weighed pickups and a record of every hand-off.

footer.about: India's scrap chain on one platform, from the home to the factory. Every hand-off weighed, priced and recorded.

trade.title: Trade
trade.summary: Businesses trade material up the chain, with payments held in escrow until delivery.

record.title: Record
record.summary: Every hand-off is recorded, ready for compliance, impact and proof of recycling.

principles.heading: Built to stand up to an audit
principles.intro: A buyer, a regulator or an auditor may ask where material came from. The record is designed so the answer is always there.

auditable.title: Every change is on the record
auditable.body: Each step (a pickup weighed, a trade paid, a load delivered) writes an entry to an audit log that is never edited in place.

exact.title: Numbers that never drift
exact.body: Money is kept in whole paise and mass in whole grams. No rounding error can build up between a weighbridge and a settlement.

frozen.title: History stays as it was
frozen.body: Every receipt keeps the price and weight of its day. Changing a price later never rewrites a receipt that already exists.

epr.title: EPR rules

standards.metaDescription: Open material codes and simple rules for fair scrap trade in India: grading, weighing, receipts, verification and escrow. Free for anyone to adopt.
standards.title: The Luma.Green standard
standards.lead: Simple, open rules for trading scrap fairly: one code for every material, clear grading, honest weighing and a record at every hand-off. Anyone in the industry can adopt them.

codes.title: One code for every material
codes.body: The same scrap goes by many local names. An open code gives each material one name everyone can use, so a kilo of newspaper means the same thing at a shop, a yard and a factory.
codes.caption: Luma.Green material codes
codes.unavailable: The code list isn't available right now. Please check back soon.

grading.title: Grading: dry, sorted, clean
grading.body: A fair price needs a clear grade. Three checks come before any weighing.

dry.title: Dry
dry.body: Water is not scrap. Wet paper and cardboard are dried before they are weighed.

sorted.title: Sorted
sorted.body: One material per bag or bale, under one code. A mixed load goes under a MIXED code.

clean.title: No contamination
clean.body: No food, oil, soil or stones. Anything that isn't the material comes out first.

weighing.title: Fair weighing
weighing.body: Most arguments in scrap are about weight. These rules keep the scale honest.

stamped.title: Stamped scales
stamped.body: Weigh only on a scale verified and stamped by the Legal Metrology department.

shown.title: The seller sees the weight
shown.body: The display faces the seller, and the weight is read out before a price is agreed.

receipt.title: A digital receipt
receipt.body: The weight goes on a receipt to the gram, never rounded in anyone's favour.

custody.title: Receipts and chain of custody
custody.body: Every hand-off gets a receipt. Receipts link from step to step, so a bale at a recycler can be traced back to the shops it came from.

fields.total: Total, and how it was paid

verification.title: Verification
verification.body: A person checks every business and every Saathi before they can trade.
verification.business: Businesses: the GST number if they have one, photos of the shop or unit, and a phone call.
verification.consent: Yards, recyclers and factories: a valid consent from the state pollution control board.
verification.saathi: Saathis: a photo ID and a selfie that matches it.

escrow.title: Escrow between businesses
escrow.body: In a trade between businesses, nobody ships or pays on trust alone. The money waits in escrow until the goods arrive.

steps.released: The buyer confirms, and the money is released

adopt.title: Use the standard
adopt.body: The codes and rules are open and free. Use them in your shop, yard or factory, on Luma.Green or off it, and tell us what would make them better.

howItWorks.metaDescription: How scrap moves on Luma.Green: sold from home at a fair price, traded up the chain with escrow, and recorded at every hand-off.
howItWorks.title: How Luma.Green works
howItWorks.lead: Scrap changes hands four times before it becomes something new. Here is what happens at each step, and what Luma.Green records.

sell.body: A household picks what it has, sees each nearby shop's offer and books a pickup or a drop-off. The kabadiwala weighs each material and pays in cash or UPI, and both get a receipt.
sell.point1: Each shop sets its own prices, never below the published floor
sell.point2: Weights recorded in grams from the shop's scale
sell.point3: A tracking link, with no account needed

trade.body: Kabadiwalas sell sorted stock to yards, yards sell bales to recyclers, and recyclers sell flakes, granules and ingots to factories. The buyer's payment waits in escrow until the goods arrive.
trade.point2: Stock moves when a load is dispatched and received
trade.point3: A numbered trade receipt for every paid trade

record.body: Every hand-off is written down: who, what, how much, when and where. That record powers the price board, stock, compliance and impact figures, and is the evidence EPR and recycling standards ask for.
record.point1: One record from the door to the factory
record.point2: EPR totals by financial year for recyclers and factories
record.point3: Supporting evidence for credits, never counted twice

signIn.title: Sign in with an SMS code
signIn.summary: No password. Your mobile number and a 6-digit code are all you need.

open.title: Open the sign-in page
open.body: Go to luma.green/login and choose your language.

number.title: Enter your mobile number
number.body: Type the 10-digit number you joined with.

code.title: Type the 6-digit code
code.body: We send it by SMS. It works for 5 minutes. No SMS after 30 seconds? Tap Resend.

stay.title: Stay signed in
stay.body: You stay signed in on that phone for 30 days. Never share your code: our team will never ask for it.

safetyAtWork.title: Stay safe at work
safetyAtWork.summary: Safety gear, lifting, sharp scrap, batteries and machines: the basics that prevent injuries.

gear.title: Wear your safety gear (PPE)
gear.body: Gloves and closed shoes, always. Add a mask for dusty loads and goggles when cutting or crushing.

lift.title: Lift with your legs
lift.body: Bend your knees, keep the load close and don't twist. Get help with anything over 25 kg.

sharp.title: Watch for sharp edges
sharp.body: Glass, tin and wire cut easily. Carry glass in a box, never loose in a sack.

batteries.title: Keep batteries and e-waste apart
batteries.body: Store them dry and cool, away from other scrap. Never burn wires or break open batteries or screens.

machines.title: Switch off before you clear a jam
machines.body: Stop a baler or shredder and unplug it first. Never reach in while it runs.

firstAid.title: Keep first aid close
firstAid.body: Keep a first-aid kit and clean water on site. For a deep cut or a burn, get medical help at once.

verifyBusiness.title: Join and get verified
verifyBusiness.summary: What to have ready, and what our team checks before your business goes live.

start.title: Start at luma.green/join
start.body: Sign in with your mobile number and choose Yard, Recycler or Manufacturer.

details.title: Add your business details
details.body: Name, address and map pin, the materials you handle and your working hours. GST is optional.

consent.title: Add your pollution-board consent
consent.body: Your KSPCB consent, or your state board's: its number, the valid-until date and the certificate as a PDF.

photos.title: Add machine photos
photos.body: At least two photos or short videos of your main machines and your site.

review.title: We check within 12–24 hours
review.body: A person checks every document. If something is missing, we tell you exactly what to fix.

live.title: Start trading
live.body: Once you're approved, your dashboard opens and buyers and sellers near you can find you.

escrow.title: How escrow keeps a trade safe
escrow.summary: The buyer's money is held safely until the load arrives as agreed.

request.title: The buyer sends a request
request.body: It shows the material, the kilos and the price per kg.

accept.title: The seller accepts
accept.body: Nothing is paid yet. Call each other if you need to agree details.

pay.title: The buyer pays into escrow
pay.body: The money is held safely, not yet with the seller. The seller can see it's there before loading.

dispatch.title: The seller sends the load
dispatch.body: Mark it as sent. The invoice travels with it, and an e-way bill when one is needed.

confirm.title: The buyer confirms delivery
confirm.body: Check the weight and quality, then confirm. The money is released to the seller.

paperwork.title: Invoices and e-way bills
paperwork.summary: The papers that travel with every load.

invoice.title: Get the invoice from the trade
invoice.body: Every trade has an invoice you can open, print or share.

ewayBill.title: E-way bill over ₹50,000
ewayBill.body: GST rules need an e-way bill to move goods worth more than ₹50,000. Some states set a different limit.

vehicle.title: Papers go with the vehicle
vehicle.body: Carry the invoice and e-way bill in the vehicle, and check the vehicle number matches.

keep.title: Keep your records
keep.body: Receipts and invoices stay in the app for 6 years, the time tax law asks for.

tradeDisputes.title: When a load doesn't match
tradeDisputes.summary: What to do if the weight or quality isn't what you agreed.

check.title: Check before you confirm
check.body: Weigh the load and look at the quality when it arrives, while the driver is there.

hold.title: Don't confirm a short load
hold.body: Confirming releases the money. Until you confirm, it stays in escrow.

report.title: Report it with photos
report.body: Call us or write from Help, Contact us. Add photos of the weighing slip and the material.

settle.title: We help both sides agree
settle.body: We look at the weights, photos and messages from both of you. The money stays safe until it's settled.

carbonEpr.title: Carbon credits and EPR, simply
carbonEpr.summary: Why recorded recycling matters, and what brands and recyclers must know.

record.title: Every kilo is recorded
record.body: Each weighing and trade on Luma.Green is logged with the material, weight, date and place.

carbon.title: Recycling saves carbon
carbon.body: Making things from recycled material uses less energy than making them new. That saving can later become carbon credits.

epr.title: EPR: makers must take back
epr.body: Extended Producer Responsibility means brands that sell packaging, electronics or batteries must get a share of that waste recycled.

certificates.title: Recyclers issue EPR certificates
certificates.body: Registered recyclers issue certificates on the CPCB portal for what they recycle. Brands buy them to meet their targets.

proof.title: Clean records are your proof
proof.body: Our trail from home to factory shows where material came from. Carbon credits on Luma.Green come later.

firstPickup.title: Book your first pickup
firstPickup.summary: From photo to booked pickup in about two minutes. No account needed.

photo.title: Take a photo of your scrap
photo.body: Open luma.green/sell and photograph your pile. More than one photo is fine.

estimate.title: Check the estimate
estimate.body: We show what we see and roughly how many kilos. Change the kilos if they look wrong.

choose.title: Choose pickup or drop-off
choose.body: See verified kabadiwalas near you, nearest first, with their hours.

slot.title: Pick a time
slot.body: Choose a time slot, then check your address and map pin.

code.title: Confirm your number
code.body: Type the 6-digit code we send by SMS. That's all: no password.

track.title: Get your tracking link
track.body: We SMS you a link to follow your pickup.

getReady.title: Get your scrap ready
getReady.summary: Sorted, dry scrap is weighed faster and sells for more.

paper.title: Keep paper dry and flat
paper.body: Stack newspapers and flatten boxes. Wet paper is worth less.

bottles.title: Empty and squash bottles
bottles.body: Pour out any liquid and press plastic bottles flat to save space.

metal.title: Keep metal apart
metal.body: Put tins, steel and aluminium in their own bag.

ewaste.title: Set gadgets and batteries aside
ewaste.body: Keep old phones, chargers and batteries in a separate box, away from heat.

door.title: Put the bags near the door
door.body: It makes the pickup quick. Keep them somewhere dry.

trackPickup.title: Track your pickup
trackPickup.summary: When, who and how much, all on one page.

open.title: Open the link in your SMS
open.body: It works on any phone. You don't need to sign in.

when.title: See when
when.body: Your date and time slot. We tell you if anything changes.

who.title: See who is coming
who.body: Their name, shop and verified badge. Tap Call to talk to them.

after.title: See what you got
after.body: After the pickup, the page shows what you were paid and your recycle points.

weighingAtDoor.title: Weighing and payment at your door
weighingAtDoor.summary: How to make sure every kilo counts.

zero.title: Check the scale reads zero
zero.body: Before anything goes on, the empty scale should show 0.

each.title: Each material is weighed on its own
each.body: Paper, plastic and metal have different prices, so they're weighed apart.

amount.title: The app works out the amount
amount.body: Kilos times the kabadiwala's price per kg. You see the total before you're paid.

pay.title: Get paid on the spot
pay.body: In cash or UPI, before they leave. Luma.Green never holds your money.

receipt.title: Check your receipt
receipt.body: Your tracking page shows each material, its weight and price, and the total.

howPricesWork.title: How prices are set
howPricesWork.summary: Why the estimate is a range, and how the final amount is worked out.

estimate.title: Estimates use city prices
estimate.body: Before you choose a kabadiwala, we use standard Bengaluru prices, so you see a range.

own.title: Each kabadiwala sets a price
own.body: Once you choose one, you see their own price for each material.

floor.title: Never below the minimum
floor.body: Luma.Green sets a minimum price for every material. No kabadiwala can pay less.

final.title: The weight decides the amount
final.body: You're paid for what is weighed at your door, at that kabadiwala's price.

cancelBooking.title: Cancel or change a booking
cancelBooking.summary: Plans change. Here's what to do.

open.title: Open your tracking link
open.body: Everything about your booking is there.

cancel.title: Cancel for free
cancel.body: You can cancel until the kabadiwala is on the way. It costs nothing.

declined.title: If a kabadiwala can't come
declined.body: We offer your pickup to the next nearest one and tell you by SMS.

help.title: Need a different time?
help.body: Cancel and book again, or call us and we'll help.

batteriesAtHome.title: Old phones, batteries and e-waste
batteriesAtHome.summary: Safe to keep at home, safe to hand over.

apart.title: Keep them in one dry box
apart.body: Away from the stove, water and sunlight, and out of children's reach.

tape.title: Tape the battery ends
tape.body: Put tape over the metal ends so they can't spark.

swollen.title: Don't press a swollen battery
swollen.body: A puffed-up battery can catch fire. Keep it on its own in a metal tin and tell the kabadiwala.

handover.title: Hand gadgets over whole
handover.body: Don't break phones or take out parts. Say it's e-waste when you book.

registerShop.title: Register your shop
registerShop.summary: What to fill in, and how long the check takes.

start.title: Start at luma.green/join
start.body: Sign in with your mobile number and choose Kabadiwala.

shop.title: Add your shop
shop.body: Your name, shop name, address with a map pin, and opening hours.

pickups.title: Say if you do pickups
pickups.body: Pick your vehicle: handcart, cycle, auto or mini-truck. No vehicle? Households can still drop off.

gst.title: GST is optional
gst.body: Add your GST number if you have one. If not, just say so.

review.title: We check within 12–24 hours
review.body: A person checks your details. When you're approved, your dashboard opens.

pickupRequests.title: Answer pickup requests
pickupRequests.summary: New pickups from households near you, and how to handle them.

see.title: See new requests
see.body: Each shows the area, time slot, materials, rough kilos and what you'd pay.

answer.title: Accept or reject
answer.body: Accept to take it. If you reject, it goes to the next nearest kabadiwala, and the household isn't told who.

auto.title: Turn on auto-accept
auto.body: With auto-accept on, every request in your area is accepted at once, even at night.

go.title: Call and go
go.body: Once you accept, you see the phone number and exact address. Call to say you're on the way.

weighAndPay.title: Weigh and pay
weighAndPay.summary: Record a pickup in under a minute.

zero.title: Zero the scale
zero.body: Start from 0 with nothing on it, where the household can see.

weigh.title: Weigh each material
weigh.body: Enter the kilos for each one. Use + and − for half-kilo steps.

total.title: Show the total
total.body: The app works it out from your prices. Show the screen to the household.

pay.title: Pay in cash or UPI
pay.body: Pay before you leave, and choose how you paid.

save.title: Save
save.body: The household sees the receipt on their tracking page, and your stock goes up by what you weighed.

setPrices.title: Set your prices
setPrices.summary: You choose what you pay, above the minimum.

open.title: Open My prices
open.body: You see every material with the minimum price beside it.

enter.title: Enter your price per kg
enter.body: Type what you want to pay households for each material.

floor.title: Stay above the minimum
floor.body: A price below the minimum isn't saved. If the minimum goes up, your price goes up too, and we tell you.

blank.title: Leave a material blank
blank.body: If you set no price, the city's standard price is used.

history.title: Old receipts don't change
history.body: A new price counts only for new pickups. Past receipts keep the price that was paid.

stockAndSell.title: Sort your stock and sell to yards
stockAndSell.summary: From many small pickups to a load a yard wants.

grows.title: Your stock fills up by itself
grows.body: Every pickup you weigh is added to My stock.

sort.title: Record your sorting
sort.body: Split mixed scrap into what it really is. For example, mixed paper into newspaper, cardboard and waste.

show.title: Show your stock to yards
show.body: Turn on Show to yards so yards near you can see what you have.

sell.title: Accept a yard's request
sell.body: Check the kilos and the price, then accept. The yard pays into escrow before collecting.

householdDisagrees.title: When a household disagrees
householdDisagrees.summary: Stay calm, be clear and keep it fair.

reweigh.title: Weigh again together
reweigh.body: Zero the scale and weigh the item again where they can see.

show.title: Show your price
show.body: Show the price per kg and the total on your phone.

noForce.title: Don't force a sale
noForce.body: If they still don't agree, they don't have to sell that material. Leave it out of the receipt.

call.title: Call us if you're stuck
call.body: We can talk to both of you. Every receipt shows the weights and prices.

buyFromKabadiwalas.title: Buy stock from kabadiwalas
buyFromKabadiwalas.summary: Find sorted scrap near you and book a collection.

browse.title: Open Buy
browse.body: See stock near you by material and distance, with the kilos and price.

request.title: Send a request
request.body: Choose how many kilos you want. The price per kg is shown before you send.

pay.title: Pay into escrow
pay.body: When the kabadiwala accepts, pay. The money is held until you confirm.

collect.title: Collect and weigh
collect.body: Pick up the load and weigh it at your yard.

confirm.title: Confirm to release payment
confirm.body: If the weight and quality are right, confirm. The kabadiwala is paid.

sellToRecyclers.title: Sell sorted bales to recyclers
sellToRecyclers.summary: List what you have once, and let recyclers come to you.

list.title: List what you have
list.body: In Sell, add the material, the kilos and your price per kg.

requests.title: Get requests
requests.body: Recyclers who buy that material can see your listing and send a request.

accept.title: Accept, then wait for payment
accept.body: Load only once the buyer's money is in escrow.

dispatch.title: Send the load
dispatch.body: Mark it as sent, with the invoice, and an e-way bill for loads over ₹50,000.

paid.title: Get paid
paid.body: When the recycler confirms delivery, the money is released to you.

buyFromYards.title: Buy sorted scrap from yards
buyFromYards.summary: Steady, graded input for your line.

browse.title: Find bales near you
browse.body: Open Buy to see yards' listings by material and distance.

request.title: Request a load
request.body: Choose the kilos. The price per kg is shown before you send.

pay.title: Pay into escrow
pay.body: Once the yard accepts, pay. The money is held until you confirm delivery.

confirm.title: Weigh, check, confirm
confirm.body: Weigh the load at your gate and check the grade before you confirm.

sellRecycled.title: Sell recycled material to manufacturers
sellRecycled.summary: Show what your line makes, so factories can order.

list.title: List your output
list.body: Add flakes, granules, bales or ingots with the kilos you have and your price per kg.

orders.title: Get orders
orders.body: Manufacturers see your listing and send requests for the kilos they need.

load.title: Load after payment
load.body: Accept, then send the load once the payment is in escrow.

paid.title: Get paid on delivery
paid.body: The money is released when the manufacturer confirms.

orderRecycled.title: Order recycled material
orderRecycled.summary: Find recycled input and order what you need.

browse.title: See what recyclers have
browse.body: Open Buy to see recycled material by type, kilos available and price.

order.title: Send an order
order.body: Choose the kilos and send. The recycler accepts or declines.

pay.title: Pay into escrow
pay.body: Pay once they accept. The money is held until you confirm delivery.

receive.title: Receive the load
receive.body: Weigh it and check the grade at your gate.

confirm.title: Confirm delivery
confirm.body: Confirm to release the payment to the recycler.

checkDelivery.title: Check a delivery
checkDelivery.summary: A quick check before you confirm and release payment.

papers.title: Match the papers
papers.body: The invoice and e-way bill should match your order and the vehicle.

weigh.title: Weigh it yourself
weigh.body: Weigh the truck full and empty. The difference is what you received.

look.title: Look at the material
look.body: Check colour, moisture and dirt against what you ordered.

decide.title: Confirm or report
decide.body: All good? Confirm. Not right? Report it with photos, and the money stays in escrow.

becomeSaathi.title: Become a Saathi
becomeSaathi.summary: Join with a photo ID and a selfie, and start taking jobs near you.

start.title: Start at luma.green/join
start.body: Sign in with your mobile number and choose Saathi.

work.title: Choose your work
work.body: Home pickups, help at a kabadiwala shop, sorting at a yard, or shifts at a recycler or factory.

area.title: Set your area and times
area.body: Where you live, how far you'll travel (2, 5 or 10 km) and when you're free.

id.title: Add a photo ID and a selfie
id.body: Voter ID, driving licence, PAN or a masked Aadhaar. Never a full Aadhaar number.

review.title: We check within 12–24 hours
review.body: A person matches your selfie to your ID. Then you can take jobs.

findJobs.title: Find and take jobs
findJobs.summary: Work near you, when you want it.

home.title: See jobs on Home
home.body: Each job shows the place, day, time and pay.

accept.title: Accept a job
accept.body: Tap Accept. The business can see you're coming.

arrive.title: Be on time
arrive.body: Call ahead if you'll be late. Being on time gets you more work.

done.title: Mark it done
done.body: After the job, mark it done so it shows in your earnings.

homePickup.title: Do a home pickup
homePickup.summary: Friendly, quick and fair at every door.

call.title: Call before you go
call.body: Say your name, which shop you're from and when you'll arrive.

greet.title: Introduce yourself
greet.body: At the door, say your name and the shop's name. Wait to be invited in.

weigh.title: Weigh where they can see
weigh.body: Zero the scale and weigh each material in front of them.

record.title: Pay and record
record.body: Pay as the shop has asked, and save the payment before you leave.

deliver.title: Bring it to the shop
deliver.body: Take the scrap straight to the shop and hand it over.

saathiPay.title: How you get paid
saathiPay.summary: Agree the pay first, then check it in Earnings.

agree.title: Agree the pay first
agree.body: The shop or business you work for pays you. Agree the amount before the job starts.

earnings.title: Check Earnings
earnings.body: See the jobs you've done and what each one paid.

upi.title: Ask for UPI
upi.body: UPI leaves a record, so there's never a doubt about what you got.

problem.title: Not paid?
problem.body: Talk to the business first. Still stuck? Call us.

noCode.q: I didn't get the SMS code
noCode.a: Wait 30 seconds and tap Resend. Check the number is right and your phone has signal. A code works for 5 minutes.

newPhone.q: I have a new phone or a new number
newPhone.a: New phone, same number: just sign in again. New number: call us, and we'll move your account once we've checked it's you.

deleteData.q: Can I see or delete my data?
deleteData.a: Yes. Write to us from Contact and we'll do it within 30 days. We keep only what the law needs, such as receipts.

verifyTime.q: How long does the check take?
verifyTime.a: Usually 12 to 24 hours after you send your application. If we need anything else, we tell you exactly what.

noAccount.a: No. You confirm your mobile number with an SMS code when you book. There's no password to remember.

whatCanISell.a: Paper and cardboard, plastic bottles and containers, metal, glass and old electronics. Not sure? Take a photo and the estimate will tell you.

howPriceWorks.q: How is my money worked out?
howPriceWorks.a: The weight of each material times the kabadiwala's price per kg. Their price can never be below the minimum Luma.Green sets.

howPaid.a: At your door, in cash or UPI, before the kabadiwala leaves. Luma.Green records the payment but never holds your money.

recyclePoints.a: A thank-you for recycling: 1 point for every ₹10 you're paid. What you can use them for is coming soon.

weightWrong.q: What if the weight looks wrong?
weightWrong.a: Ask them to weigh it again in front of you, starting from zero. Still not right? Call us: the receipt shows every weight.

canCancel.a: Yes, for free, until the kabadiwala is on the way. Open your tracking link and tap Cancel.

kabadiwalasChecked.a: Yes. Our team checks every shop before it can take bookings. Look for the verified badge.

whoSeesAddress.q: Who sees my number and address?
whoSeesAddress.a: Only the kabadiwala who accepts your pickup, and our team. We keep them for 12 months after your last booking.

photosKept.a: They are used only for your estimate and deleted within 90 days.

whyVerify.q: Why do I have to be verified?
whyVerify.a: Households trust you at their door. Checking every shop keeps them safe and makes your verified badge mean something.

gstNeeded.q: Do I need a GST number?
gstNeeded.a: No, it's optional. Add it if you have one.

ownPrices.q: Can I set my own prices?
ownPrices.a: Yes, for every material, as long as it's not below the minimum price Luma.Green sets.

noVehicle.q: I don't have a vehicle. Can I still join?
noVehicle.a: Yes. Households can bring scrap to your shop. Saathi pickups for shops without a vehicle are coming later.

autoAccept.a: When it's on, every new request in your area is accepted straight away, even at night. Turn it off when you can't go.

rejectRequest.q: What happens if I reject a request?
rejectRequest.a: It goes to the next nearest kabadiwala. The household isn't told who said no.

payHousehold.q: Does Luma.Green pay the household for me?
payHousehold.a: No. You pay them in cash or UPI at the door. The app records how much and how.

paidByYard.q: How am I paid when I sell to a yard?
paidByYard.a: The yard pays into escrow before collecting. When they confirm the load, the money is released to you.

whoSeesShop.a: Once you're approved, your shop name, area and hours are public so households can find you. Your documents stay private.

consentDocs.a: Your pollution-board consent (KSPCB in Karnataka) with its number, valid-until date and certificate as a PDF, plus photos of your machines. GST is optional.

noConsentNeeded.q: My unit doesn't need a consent. Can I still join?
noConsentNeeded.a: Yes. Tick the box that says your unit doesn't need one, and tell us why, for example paper baling only. We check it.

consentExpiry.q: What happens when my consent expires?
consentExpiry.a: We remind you 30 days before. Upload the renewed certificate to keep trading.

findStock.q: How do I find stock near me?
findStock.a: Open Buy. Stock from verified kabadiwalas is shown by material, nearest first.

whoSetsPrice.a: The seller lists a price per kg. You see it before you send a request, and you can call to agree details.

whatIsEscrow.a: A safe middle step: the buyer's money is held until the load arrives as agreed, then released to the seller.

whenSellerPaid.a: As soon as the buyer confirms delivery.

shortLoad.q: What if a load is short?
shortLoad.a: Don't confirm it. Report it with photos of the weighing slip. The money stays in escrow while we sort it out.

ewayBill.q: Do I need an e-way bill?
ewayBill.a: Yes, to move goods worth more than ₹50,000, and the trade screen reminds you. Some states set a different limit.

whoSeesBusiness.a: Verified buyers and sellers see your name, area and the materials you handle. Only you and our team see your documents.

pwpRegistration.q: I recycle plastic. Do I need anything more?
pwpRegistration.a: Keep your CPCB Plastic Waste Processor registration ready. Brands ask for it, and it lets you issue EPR certificates.

buyFromAnyYard.q: Can I buy from more than one yard?
buyFromAnyYard.a: Yes. Buy from any verified yard that lists what you need, as often as you like.

eprRecords.q: Do Luma.Green records help with EPR?
eprRecords.a: Yes. Every trade records the material, weight, date and seller, which backs up your EPR filings. You still file on the CPCB portal.

carbonCredits.a: Not yet. We record every kilo now so credits can be issued later, once the method is verified.

whatCanIBuy.a: Recycled material from verified recyclers, such as PET flakes, HDPE granules, kraft paper and aluminium ingots.

qualityWrong.q: What if the quality isn't what I ordered?
qualityWrong.a: Don't confirm. Report it with photos. The money stays in escrow while we help you and the recycler agree.

recycledContent.q: Does buying recycled help with EPR?
recycledContent.a: Yes. Plastic EPR rules set recycled-content targets for packaging, and your trade records show how much recycled material you bought.

carbonClaims.a: Your Impact screen estimates the carbon saved. Treat these numbers as indicative until they are independently verified.

whoCanJoin.a: Anyone 18 or older who wants to earn from short jobs near home.

whichId.a: Voter ID, driving licence, PAN, a DigiLocker document, or an Aadhaar that shows only the last 4 digits.

fullAadhaar.a: We never keep Aadhaar numbers. If you upload a full one by mistake, we'll ask for a masked copy and delete the first.

needVehicle.a: No. Shop help and shifts don't need one. For home pickups, a cycle, bike or auto helps.

whoPaysMe.a: The kabadiwala or business you work for. Agree the amount before you start.

chooseHours.q: Can I choose when I work?
chooseHours.a: Yes. You tell us the times and days you're free, and you take only the jobs you want.

safetyGear.q: What safety gear do I need?
safetyGear.a: Gloves and closed shoes for every job, and a mask for dusty work. Ask the business if they need anything more.

whoSeesId.q: Who sees my ID and selfie?
whoSeesId.a: Only you and our team, to check it's really you.

jobWentWrong.q: Something went wrong on a job. What do I do?
jobWentWrong.a: First, stay safe. Tell the business, then call us. We'll listen to both sides.

whatRecycles.p3: Food waste and dirty nappies can't be recycled.

batteriesSafe.p3: Never throw them in the bin or a fire.

fairWeigh.p3: Check the total on your receipt.

weighingFairly.p3: Show the total before you pay.
